definitions.explanation: A stone used for sharpening blades such as kitchen knives, scissors, or tools. Water is typically applied to the stone while grinding the blade against its surface.

examples.japanese: ⟦{包丁|ほうちょう}→包丁：04976_houchou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{砥石|といし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{研|と}いだ→研ぐ：04377_togu⟧。
examples.english: I sharpened the kitchen knife with a whetstone.

examples.japanese: {砥石|といし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{浸|ひた}しておく→浸す：07506_hitasu⟧。
examples.english: Soak the whetstone in water before using it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{料理人|りょうりにん}→料理人：19396_ryourinin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{砥石|といし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Chefs take good care of their own whetstones.

notes:
TYPES BY GRIT:
・⟦{荒砥|あらと}→荒砥：noentry⟧ (coarse whetstone) - for initial sharpening, fixing chips
・⟦{中砥|なかと}→中砥：noentry⟧ (medium whetstone) - general sharpening
・⟦{仕上|しあ}げ→仕上げ：11519_shiage⟧⟦{砥|と}→砥：noentry⟧ (finishing stone) - for final polish

FAMOUS WHETSTONES:
・⟦{天然|てんねん}→天然：03560_tennen⟧{砥石|といし} (natural whetstone)
・⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{天然|てんねん}→天然：03560_tennen⟧{砥石|といし} (Kyoto natural stones) - highly valued
・⟦{人造|じんぞう}→人造：04284_jinzou⟧{砥石|といし} (synthetic whetstone)

USAGE:
・⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧{砥石|といし} (water stone) - most common type in Japan
・⟦{油砥石|あぶらといし}→油砥石：noentry⟧ (oil stone) - uses oil instead of water

RELATED TOOLS:
・⟦{包丁|ほうちょう}→包丁：04976_houchou⟧ (kitchen knife)
・⟦{研|と}ぎ{器|き}→研ぎ器：noentry⟧ (knife sharpener - simpler alternative)
・⟦{革砥|かわと}→革砥：noentry⟧ (leather strop) - for final polishing

TRADITIONAL KNOWLEDGE:
・Japanese blade sharpening (⟦{研|と}ぎ→研ぐ：04377_togu⟧) is considered a skill
・Professional sharpeners (⟦{研|と}ぎ{師|し}→研ぎ師：noentry⟧) still exist
・Proper angle and pressure are crucial

COLLOCATIONS:
・{砥石|といし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{研|と}ぐ→研ぐ：04377_togu⟧ (to sharpen with a whetstone)
・{砥石|といし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{浸|ひた}す→浸す：07506_hitasu⟧ (to soak the whetstone)
